records.subject: Integrated external heat source–DC-SOFC–VTIG–regenerator system
records.quote: A novel integrated system consisting of an external heat source, a direct carbon solid oxide fuel cell (DC-SOFC), a vacuum thermionic generator (VTIG) and a regenerator is proposed to handle the heat management of the DC-SOFC.

records.subject: Overall heat released in the DC-SOFC
records.object: Heat required by the internal Boudouard reaction
records.quote: The electrochemical/chemical reactions, ionic/electronic charge transport, mass/momentum transport and heat transfer are fully considered in the 2D tubular DC-SOFC model, which shows that the overall heat released in the cell is always different from the heat required by the internal Boudouard reaction.
records.conditions: 2D tubular DC-SOFC model accounting for electrochemical/chemical reactions, ionic/electronic charge transport, mass/momentum transport, and heat transfer.

records.subject: Three system operation strategies
records.object: Analytical expressions for overall power output and efficiency

records.conditions: Proposed integrated system.

records.subject: Vacuum thermionic generator
records.object: Waste-heat recovery for additional power production
records.conditions: Large operating current density; proposed modeled system.
records.quote: A novel integrated system consisting of an external heat source, a direct carbon solid oxide fuel cell (DC-SOFC), a vacuum thermionic generator (VTIG) and a regenerator is proposed to handle the heat management of the DC-SOFC.
context_quotes: The electrochemical/chemical reactions, ionic/electronic charge transport, mass/momentum transport and heat transfer are fully considered in the 2D tubular DC-SOFC model, which shows that the overall heat released in the cell is always different from the heat required by the internal Boudouard reaction.

The results show that the VTIG could effectively recover the waste heat for additional power production at a large operating current density, and the maximum power density and efficiency of the proposed system could reach more than 8100 W m(-2) and 60% at 30,000 A m(-2) and 1173 K, respectively.

records.subject: MX2 (M = Zr, Hf; X = S, Se) and Janus MXY (M = Zr, Hf; X = S, Y = Se)
records.object: Lower out-of-plane than in-plane compression resistance
records.conditions: Orbital hybrid theory.
records.quote: IVB-VIA transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) MX2 (M = Zr, Hf; X = S, Se) and related Janus MXY (M = Zr, Hf; X = S, Y = Se) have garnered significant attention due to their unique optoelectronic properties.
context_quotes: To further explore their potential in flexible photonics, their mechanical, band dispersion, and optical dielectric properties using orbital hybrid theory are investigated.

The results reveal that the out-of-plane linear compression resistance of these materials is considerably lower than their in-plane resistance, primarily because van der Waals interactions are much weaker compared to ionic bond interactions.
modality_evidence: To further explore their potential in flexible photonics, their mechanical, band dispersion, and optical dielectric properties using orbital hybrid theory are investigated.

records.subject: K2LiBiX6 (X = Cl, Br, I) double perovskites
records.quote: This study demonstrates the structural, mechanical, acoustic and thermal, electronic and optical properties of K2LiBiX6 (X=Cl, Br, I) bismuth-based halide double perovskites.
context_quotes: The density functional theory (DFT)-based Full-potential linearized augmented plane wave (FP-LAPW) scheme is used, with the WIEN2k simulation code.
These compounds possess a face-centered cubic crystal structure and satisfy the Goldschmidt tolerance and octahedral factor (to and mu o) criteria.
modality_evidence: The density functional theory (DFT)-based Full-potential linearized augmented plane wave (FP-LAPW) scheme is used, with the WIEN2k simulation code.
records.conditions: DFT FP-LAPW using WIEN2k.
